validity_rules: classification must distinguish imposed treatments, randomization, control/placebo/blinding, and confounding

sources.note: the item stem's verb must match the scored demand

prompt: One teacher uses a new review method in the morning class and the old method in the afternoon class, then compares exam scores. Which statement best identifies the design element or flaw?

options.text: Class time is confounded with review method, because each method is tied to a different class period.
This is randomized because the teacher chose which period got each method.

misconception_source.label: Confused control, blinding, placebo, and randomization

sources.note: randomization, control, placebo, and blinding serve different roles in experimental design

options.text: There is no confounding because both classes have the same teacher.

misconception_source.label: Confused confounding with a lurking variable or unrelated association

sources.note: experimental and observational designs require identifying confounding and other design flaws

options.text: This is only observational because exam scores are observed after class.

misconception_source.label: Treated an observational study as an experiment

sources.note: observational studies do not impose treatments; experiments do
